notes: No article stands before οἴκου or Ἰσραήλ, so the supplied the belongs to house under rule 51's anarthrous clause and of rides with each noun under rule 21's determinerless clause.
τὰ πρόβατα τὰ ἀπολωλότα leaves the second attributive article unrepresented under rule 23, the ASV rendering the participle as a bare attributive adjective with no relativizer to place.
